status: Parametric unmeasured concept; no working pipette or fabrication release

radiusCoarse.description: Assumed 10 mL barrel inner radius; not a measured article

spacing.description: Assumed spacing of the two syringe axes

axisZ.description: Assumed syringe and valve flow-axis height

pipeBore.description: Assumed air-line inner radius; not a chosen hose

headSeatRadius.description: Assumed common head coupling outer radius; no standardized fit

headTravel.description: Illustrative separation for showing head removal

connections.syringe_ports: Luer-Lock intended; envelope only. No standard taper, thread, fit or gas-tightness claim.
connections.head_coupling: Common illustrative face-and-collar interface, independent of the pipette-tip cone

limitations: Every construction dimension is a design assumption; actual manufacturer dimensions and parts remain unknown.
Derived barrel stroke gives the nominal geometric swept capacity only, never a measured or calibrated dispensed volume.
Valve bores and closure witnesses illustrate topology; clearances, missing seals and pressure behavior are not qualified.
Luer-Lock collars are illustrative envelopes without standard taper or locking threads; do not manufacture or claim compatibility from them.
Micro and macro heads are independent illustrative tip profiles, not selected consumables or calibrated volume ranges.
Head removal is a CAD presentation state, not a robot tool changer. No firmware, device adapter or liquid transfer is implemented.
Motor and lead-screw shapes are envelopes without selected pitch, force, backlash, bearings or position feedback.
No robot flange attachment, reach study, workspace placement or automatic tip ejection has been qualified.
